dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized in the lower lateral region and dispersed between larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most isolated 'O' rings in the central dorsal field form a near-equilateral triangular relationship, while the larger anterior cluster and posterior rings define an elongated longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive, high-contrast amorphous patch on the anterior-lateral flank featuring a complex, non-repeating fractal perimeter that transitions into a dense field of smaller, interlocking light-intensity regions.
